title: Ammonia Synthesis Activity of Alumina-Supported Ruthenium Catalyst Enhanced by Alumina Phase Transformation
extraction_notes: No eligible SI plotted catalytic-performance data were extracted. SI Figure S11 is a reaction-order plot (log C vs log partial pressure) and SI Figure S12 is an Arrhenius plot (ln rate vs 1000/T), both explicitly excluded by the instructions. Other SI figures are characterization/TPD/TPR/MS/titration/NMR/Rietveld plots rather than measured NH3 synthesis performance.
